definition: two pouches connected at one side of their mouth so that it can be put on the back of an animal or on one's shoulder and in both things can be filled.

definition: a monetary unit of India, equal to one hundredth of a rupee.

definition: to sleep lightly; to be half asleep; to drowse; to doze.

definition: the early part of the day when dews form on lawns.

definition: an overflowing of water in a stream, river; flood.

definition: the chief officer of a government department or the chief trustee of a trust.

definition: the act, process or an instance of performing usu. a strenuous, laborious work; toil.

definition: a break of journey for taking rest.

definition: evil reputation; bad name; infamy.

definition: a man who performs tricks on a bamboo shaft; an acrobat.

definition: of ore than normal height; tall.

definition: the red-arsenic.
example_en: They use red-arsenic in that medicine.

definition: having experience in a particular activity.

example_en: This time it rained in abundance and the crop grew well.

definition: a plant that lives on or in another plant and obtains nutriment from the later.
example: ಬಿಂದಣಿಕೆ ಗಿಡವು ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ಗಿಡದಿಂದ ಆಹಾರ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

example_en: They got the ingredient required for this machine.

definition: a poet who has got the poetic talent by birth.
example: ಆ ಹುಟ್ಟುಕವಿ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ವಯಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲೇ ಪದ್ಯ ರಚಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That born poet composed verses at a young age itself.

definition: to beat, strike heavily, as to make fall across.
example_en: In anger he struck his opponent heavily so that he fell across.

definition: at the very centre.
example_en: He built a house at the very centre of the town.

definition: a remembering something which is past.
example_en: A recollection of the past arose in his mind.

definition: mad; intoxicated; excited from craziness.
example_en: That man was shouting like someone crazed and excited.

definition: fresh - a) newly made or obtained; b) recently arrived; just come.
example_en: Fresh vegetables are available in the market.

definition: a kind of net for catching fish.
example_en: The fishermen cast the fishing net in the pond.

definition: a lenient disposition or practice.
example: ಅವನ ಆಜಗ ಸ್ವಭಾವದಿಂದ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಅವನನ್ನು ಪ್ರೀತಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Everyone loves him for his lenient disposition.

definition: the fact of having become stale, covered or overgrown with mold, having moldy smell or taste.
example_en: A musty smell was coming from the wet sandals.

definition: a violent storm with high winds.
example_en: A violent storm rose at sea and the ships were shaken.

definition: the phase of the moon when it is on the side of the earth away from the sun, with its entire face reflecting sunlight to the earth; the full-moon.
example_en: The full moon was shining in the sky.

definition: not seeking reference of another; being absolute.
example_en: Truth is an absolute value.

definition: (a rock, tree etc.) to have moss grown on one's surface.
example_en: The stones of the pond had caught moss.

definition: any of several large-bodied, stately web-footed birds of the subfamily Anserinae, having a long, graceful neck and pure-white plumage, known as graceful swimmers; a male swan.
example_en: The male swan was swimming beautifully in the lake.

definition: to give a work (to another) to do.
example: ಮಾಲೀಕನು ಹೊಸ ಕೆಲಸಗಾರನಿಗೆ ಕೆಲಸಕೊಡು ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: The owner said to give work to the new labourer.

definition: a killing, slaughtering.
example_en: The hunter got ready for the slaughtering of the animal.
